item.title: Incarico post-doc: Nonlinear Analysis and Fragility Assessment of Structures Subjected to Fire and Post-Earthquake Fire (Univ. TRENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-02 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-07 Tecnica delle costruzioni

The research focuses on the analysis of the behaviour of structures exposed to fire, using advanced fire models and nonlinear thermomechanical analyses. Specifically, the research will investigate the analysis of: - structures in industrial facilities exposed to wildland-urban interface fires and forest fires; - bridge structures exposed to vehicle fires; - structures exposed to fires following earthquake. The development of fragility models will also be required. Finally, support will be required for the nonlinear numerical analysis of the buckling behaviour of tapered webplated steel members.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Flood risk modelling - 2026_IPD_DICA_4 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-01 Idraulica, idrologia, costruzioni idrauliche e marittime

The research activity focuses on flood hazard and risk modelling to support risk management, both under ordinary conditions and during emergencies. More specifically, the researcher will develop hydraulic models, as well as models for estimating flood damage to different exposed elements, across several case studies. The aim is to integrate modelling results into decision-making processes for flood risk management. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Incarico Post-Doc - CEAR-09/A - Fare città. Tutela e trasformazione in FVG per una cultura del progetto (Univ. TRIESTE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-04 23:59
Institution: Univ. TRIESTE, Trieste
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-09 Progettazione architettonica

The research focuses on the critical study of the recent architectural heritage of Trieste and Friuli Venezia Giulia through the work of the Celli-Tognon architectural practice (1970s–early 1980s), with particular attention to collective housing, multi-family residential buildings, public space and urban form. Activities include the survey of 40–50 works, archival research, digitisation, critical cataloguing, interpretative redrawing, and typological, morphological and urban analysis, supported by national and international comparative studies. See the call for more details.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: OPEN HOUSING. Aggregable systems, participatory processes and local supply chains for a new season of public housing (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-27 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-08 Design, tecnologia dell'architettura, architettura tecnica e gestione dell'ambiente costruito

**The research aims** to develop tools and processes that support the design and construction of open, combinable, lightweight-technology housing prototypes. These prototypes are expected to reconcile flexibility and adaptability of spaces over time, the combinability of modules into different configurations, the sustainability of materials and construction systems, the accessibility of domestic and collective spaces, and the generation of local economic and employment benefits through a construction supply chain involving small businesses and vocational training pathways.

The Federico II University Penitentiary Center at the Secondigliano P. Mandato Penitentiary Center was founded in 2017 and opened in the first academic year (2018-2019). The over 100 students are divided into two sections: the high-security "Ionio" and the medium-security "Mediterraneo."
